sentences.text: Mogibacterium is a genus of rod-shaped, anaerobic, Gram-positive bacteria whose named species include Mogibacterium timidum and Mogibacterium pumilum.
A report describes Mogibacterium timidum as one of the most common bacteria in the microbial flora of dental plaque.
A study of subgingival plaque reported that Mogibacterium timidum was found in higher quantities in chronic periodontitis patients than in healthy patients.
Another study using real-time PCR reported the highest Mogibacterium timidum counts in the diabetic chronic periodontitis group, followed by the non-diabetic chronic periodontitis group.
A study of buccal mucosa reported that the relative abundance of the oral genus Mogibacterium was significantly altered in patients with major depressive disorder compared with healthy controls.
